kind.description: LineChart wraps the @ant-design/charts Line component (AntV G2). It mirrors that library's data + field-mapping API: pass a flat `data` array and map fields to positions/color.

xField.description: field mapped to the x position (G2 `xField`)

yField.description: field mapped to the y position (G2 `yField`)

area.description: render a gradient area fill under the line (G2 `area`); defaults to false

legend.description: show the legend; false hides it (G2 `legend`)

height.description: fixed height in px (G2 `height`); omit to autofit

annotations.description: G2 annotation marks passed through (e.g. a peak `point` marker + a dashed `lineX` "now" line); usually computed server-side via a widgetDataTemplate

point.description: render a default circle marker at each data point (G2 composed `point` mark). Improves legibility of sparse series.

scale.description: G2 per-channel scale config (G2 `scale`), e.g. {"y":{"zero":true,"nice":true,"domainMin":0,"domainMax":3,"tickCount":4}}. domainMax is a floor — data larger than it still wins, so dense data is never clipped.

xTimeUnit.description: When set, `xField` values are UNIX epoch SECONDS and the x axis is TIME: points are placed by their moment, and ticks are labelled in the VIEWER's time zone, as all text is: 'hour' -> 'HH:MM', with the day ('24 Nov'; '31 Dec 2025' in another year) where it changes; 'day' -> the day. The tooltip gives the point's full date with the zone ('Tue 24 November 2026, 08:00:00 (UTC+1)'). Use this instead of server-side strftime, which is UTC and repeats across days. Annotations sharing `xField` are placed identically, so peak/now marks stay aligned.

slotField.description: The row field that says a slot is not a whole measurement: `partial` for the slot still filling (the one that holds now), `missing` for a slot where nothing was recorded (send its value as null, never 0). Any other value, or none, is a whole slot. A slot with no data breaks the line over a hatched band labelled 'No data', whose hover reads 'No data · 25 Nov, 09:50 to 10:20'; the slot still filling ends the line with a dashed segment and a hollow point labelled 'so far', and its hover value ends 'so far'. A legend entry 'so far' or 'no data' is added under the chart only when such a slot is drawn. With several series a band is drawn only where every series has no data; one series without a value breaks only its own line. Meant for a time axis (`xTimeUnit`), where the band's hover names its times in the viewer's zone.

colorMap.description: map each colorField category to a Krateo palette colour name (e.g. {"Created":"cyan"}); sets the G2 color scale domain/range so the line + points render in the brand colour, not G2's default blue palette

watch.description: live-refresh watch: involvedObject(s) this widget is tied to (see src/schemas/watch.schema.json). A matching k8s event refetches the widget.

namespace.description: scope to a namespace; omit to match any

name.description: a specific object; omit to match any object of this kind ("GVR-level")
Name of the RESTAction resource to call.

apiRef.description: Binds this widget to a RESTAction whose response feeds the widgetDataTemplate and resourcesRefsTemplate expressions. Omit it for a widget whose data is entirely static.

forPath.description: Dot-path inside widgetData whose value this expression replaces, for example `items[0].title`.

expression.description: A jq expression evaluated server-side against the apiRef response. Its result replaces the value at forPath.

widgetDataTemplate.description: Per-field overrides evaluated against the apiRef response, so one authored widget can render live cluster data. Each entry replaces one value inside widgetData.

allowed.description: Set server-side: whether the caller may perform this verb. False entries are stripped before the widget renders and are never authored by hand.

apiVersion.description: Group and version of the referenced resource, for example `widgets.templates.krateo.io/v1beta1`.

id.description: The author-chosen handle this widget uses to reference the resource, matching a resourceRefId in widgetData.

payload.description: Body sent with a mutating verb. Ignored for a GET.

verb.description: HTTP verb used to resolve the reference. GET for a read; a mutating verb makes this a write the widget can dispatch.

offset.description: Number of items to skip before the returned page.

perPage.description: Maximum items in the returned page.

continue.description: Opaque continuation token from a previous response, used to fetch the next page.

slice.description: Server-side paging for this reference: the widget receives one page rather than the whole list.

items.description: One referenced resource. The widget addresses it by its `id`, never by name.

resourcesRefs.description: The resources this widget references by id. Each entry is resolved server-side and its endpoint handed to the widget; entries the caller may not read are removed before the widget renders, so a denied reference reads as absence rather than as an error.

iterator.description: A jq expression selecting the array in the apiRef response to iterate over.

apiVersion.description: Group and version of the referenced resource, for example `widgets.templates.krateo.io/v1beta1`.

id.description: The author-chosen handle this widget uses to reference the resource, matching a resourceRefId in widgetData.

payload.description: Body sent with a mutating verb. Ignored for a GET.

verb.description: HTTP verb used to resolve the reference. GET for a read; a mutating verb makes this a write the widget can dispatch.

template.description: The resourcesRefs entry emitted for each iterated element; its fields may interpolate that element.

resourcesRefsTemplate.description: Generates resourcesRefs entries from the apiRef response — one per element the iterator yields — so a widget can reference a list whose length it does not know when authored.

spec.description: The widget's contract: its own data, an optional binding to a RESTAction, the resources it references, and any templated overrides.
